EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNAL - CLAIM FORM (ET1)

Claimant: Ms R. Vale
Respondent: Harbourfield Media Ltd

Section 5 - Details of claim

I was employed by the respondent from 14 January 2020 until
15 September 2025, when I was dismissed for alleged misconduct.

The claim was presented to the tribunal on 2 December 2025.

The claim was served on the respondent on 8 December 2025.

The respondent must file its response within 28 days of service of the
claim.

I claim unfair dismissal.
